name: Gantavya Bhatt
biography: I am a final year PhD candidate at the University of Washington, Seattle, where I am working with Prof. Jeffery A. Bilmes. I like to work on improving the data efficiency of large-scale models for both training and inference using submodular optimization. In Summer'25, I interned at NVIDIA - Applied Deep Learning Research, working with Mohammad Shoeybi and Mostafa Patwary. In summer '24, I interned at NVIDIA's Applied Deep Learning Research Team with Rafael Valle and Kevin Shih.
I am on the Industry Job Market. If you think I can be a good fit for your research roles, please don't hesitate to reach out!

Before joining the PhD program, I completed my undergraduate degree at IIT Delhi, in Electrical Engineering, where I worked with Dr Sumeet Agarwal and Dr Prathosh AP. I'm also an avid photographer (Checkout my Unsplash) and hiker! When not working, I can be found messing around with my camera, Google Earth, or hiking in North Cascades National Park.

events.html: What a remarkable year it has been! As I reflect on 2023, I am filled with gratitude for the experiences that enriched both my technical knowledge and personal growth. The journey took me to diverse corners of the world, creating memories that will linger as cherished milestones.
events.text: What a remarkable year it has been! As I reflect on 2023, I am filled with gratitude for the experiences that enriched both my technical knowledge and personal growth. The journey took me to diverse corners of the world, creating memories that will linger as cherished milestones.

events.html: The journey took me to breathtaking places, from traversing the enchanting landscapes of the Cascades to embarking on exhilarating road trips. The year came full circle as I find myself writing this from my hometown in India, reminiscent of a similar beginning the previous year. The bittersweet expedition to Los Angeles became a turning point, where I found myself captivated by the allure of Griffith Observatory, and the City of Lights seemed to shine just for me.
events.text: The journey took me to breathtaking places, from traversing the enchanting landscapes of the Cascades to embarking on exhilarating road trips. The year came full circle as I find myself writing this from my hometown in India, reminiscent of a similar beginning the previous year. The bittersweet expedition to Los Angeles became a turning point, where I found myself captivated by the allure of Griffith Observatory, and the City of Lights seemed to shine just for me.

events.html: The reopening of SR Hwy 20 paved the way for my inaugural visit to the North Cascades National Park, leaving me in awe of the majestic Liberty Bells at Washington Pass. From conquering peaks like Mailbox Peak to navigating the scenic Sahale Arm, the hiking season kicked off with a sense of accomplishment. The end of summer unfolded a picturesque Pacific Coast Highway road trip from San Francisco to Seattle, followed by an exploration of the captivating landscapes from Las Vegas to Phoenix and Southern Utah in the fall.

events.html: A week-long Thanksgiving retreat and the experience of working from Manhattan, New York hold a special place in my heart. The year concluded with a delightful loop around Olympic National Park before my flight back to India on December 12th.
